3.8 ̓Ανάστα,
Κύριε, σῶσόν με, ὁ Θεός μου, ο τι σὺ ἐπάταξας πάντας τοὺς ἐχθραί νοντάς μοι
ματαίως. ̓Οδόντας ἁμαρτωλῶν συνέτριψας. ̔Εκάστῳ ὁ Θεὸς ε χει τινὰ κατάστασιν·
οι ς τισιν ἀνέστη, τοὺς καὶ σώζει· τοὺς δὲ μα ταίως ἐχθραίνοντας πατάσσει. –
Ματαίως ἐχθραινόντων τοιοῦτον δὲ τό· ἐμίσησάν με δωρεάν· ὁποῖοι δὲ οἱ
συντριβόμενοι ὑπὸ Κυ ρίου τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν ὁδόντες, τοιοῦτοι καὶ ου τοι περὶ ω ν
ει ρηται· ἐκεῖ ε σται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων· καὶ τοῦ φα γόντος τὸν
ο μφακα αἱμωδιάσουσιν οἱ ὀδόν τες αὐτοῦ.
pass_a_gloss: Arise, Lord, save me, the God of-me, because you struck all the being-hostile to-me in-vain. Teeth of-sinners you-crushed. To-each the God has a-certain state; to-whom some he-arose, those he-also saves; the but in-vain being-hostile he-strikes. Of-in-vain being-hostile such but is this: they-hated me freely. Of-what-sort but the being-crushed by Lord of-the-sinners teeth, such also these about whom it-has-been-said: there will-be the weeping and the gnashing of-the-teeth; and of-the having-eaten the unripe-grape will-be-set-on-edge the teeth of-him.
pass_b_english: “Arise, Lord, save me, my God, because you have struck all who are hostile to me in vain. You have crushed the teeth of sinners” (Psalm 3:8). To each, God has a certain state: those for whom he has arisen, those he also saves; but those who are hostile in vain he strikes.

And of those hostile in vain, such is also this: “they hated me without a cause” (John 15:25). And of what sort are the teeth of sinners crushed by the Lord, such also are these about whom it is said: “there will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth” (Matthew 8:12); and “the teeth of the one who has eaten the unripe grape will be set on edge” (Jeremiah 31:29).

choices.term: τοῦ φαγόντος τὸν ὄμφακα αἱμωδιάσουσιν οἱ ὀδόντες αὐτοῦ
choices.english: the teeth of the one who has eaten the unripe grape will be set on edge
choices.why: ὄμφαξ is the unripe grape of the Jeremiah proverb; αἱμωδιᾶν is the teeth going numb, not blood.
rejected: the one devouring will be drenched with his own blood

choices.term: οἱ συντριβόμενοι ὑπὸ Κυρίου τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν ὀδόντες
choices.english: the teeth of sinners crushed by the Lord
choices.why: ὑπὸ Κυρίου governs the crushing; the teeth belong to sinners.
rejected: those broken by the Lord's teeth of sinners
